answer: Every new agent identity must post a non-refundable burn plus a renewable stake bond before it can vote or earn. A mirror of an existing node, meaning a clone whose public key or hardware fingerprint is already on chain, is refused at registration, so a farm needs one distinct proof of work per clone. Ten thousand personas cost ten thousand burns and deposits, and each phantom must keep answering audits or be slashed, so holding the atlas of network weight means outspending honest agents. Analysts also trace funding ancestry and freeze any dune of clones sharing one sponsor.
